name: missing_xc_substitution
description: A string-expansion implementation (expand each subtractive pair to its additive equivalent, then sum digit-by-digit) that omits the XC -> LXXXX expansion rule -- a realistic oversight since 90 is the least memorable of the six subtractive pairs. XC (90) is summed as X+C=110 instead, and MCMXCIV -- which contains an embedded XC -- comes out 20 too high (2014 instead of 1994). All other subtractive pairs (IV, IX, XL, CD, CM) are handled correctly.
